basic_details.job_title: Lady Shri Ram College For Women Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

important_dates.reporting time: 01 Hour before the scheduled time for verification of documents

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | assistant professor on guest basis: The eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor are same as prescribed for the regular Assistant Professor in UGC Regulation as adopted by the University of Delhi. Only candidates with a minimum API Score of 55 marks and above as indicated in the Guidelines for Screening and or Shortlisting of candidates for appointment of Assistant Professors in Colleges shall be eligible.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month

how_to_apply: Check the eligibility criteria as per UGC regulations and Delhi University guidelines, ensuring a minimum API score of 55 marks where applicable.
Gather self-attested copies of all required educational and category certificates along with a recent photograph.
Report to the Office of the Principal at Lady Shri Ram College For Women 01 hour before the scheduled reporting time for document verification.
Attend the walk-in interview on 15.10.2026 at 12:30 PM.
important_instructions: Reporting time for the applicants is 01 Hour before the scheduled time for verification of the documents. All candidates are required to carry their Resume along with the self-attested copies of certificates and a recent photograph. The concerned faculty would be paid Honorarium @ Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. No T.A/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The College reserves the right to change the nature & number of posts advertised or not to fill any or all the above posts without assigning any reason thereof. Any addendum/corrigendum, if any, shall be posted only on the College website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Lady Shri Ram College Assistant Professor Recruitment
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility criteria as per UGC regulations and Delhi University guidelines, ensuring a minimum API score of 55 marks where applicable. Prepare your detailed Resume. Gather self-attested copies of all required educational and category certificates along with a recent photograph. Report to the Office of the Principal at Lady Shri Ram College For Women 01 hour before the scheduled reporting time for document verification. Attend the walk-in interview on 15.10.2026 at 12:30 PM.

The concerned faculty would be paid Honorarium @ Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. No T.A/DA will be paid for attending the interview. faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by Lady Shri Ram College For Women?
faq.answer: Lady Shri Ram College For Women Delhi has announced a walk-in interview for the appointment of Assistant Professor on Guest basis in the History department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for LSR Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 04 vacancies are available for the History department.

faq.question: Q3. What are the category-wise vacancy details for History?
faq.answer: Out of 04 vacancies, 03 posts are reserved for OBC and 01 post is reserved for SC.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15.10.2026 at 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for applicants is 01 hour before the scheduled interview time for document verification.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in the Office of the Principal, Lady Shri Ram College For Women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for LSR Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are the same as prescribed for regular Assistant Professor in UGC Regulations as adopted by Delhi University, including a minimum API score of 55 marks and above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the honorarium for the guest faculty position?
faq.answer: The concerned faculty will be paid an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture up to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be carried to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Resume, self-attested copies of certificates, and a recent photograph.
